content.value: Health recovered per second = (flat regeneration + maximum Health × percentage regeneration) × (1 + Regeneration While Moving ÷ 100), with the movement multiplier active only while moving. Percentage regeneration contributes at most 5% of maximum Health per second; total regeneration is capped at 10%. Hunger does not directly regenerate Health.

Physical Damage Leeched as Life recovers a portion of Physical damage actually dealt over time. Increased Life Leech raises the amount. Each hit contributes at most 10% of maximum Health, the waiting pool holds at most 20%, and recovery is limited to 10% per second. More leech amount does not raise those limits.

[[stat/cranks-dungeons:intelligence|Intelligence]] grants +2 maximum Mana per point. Mana recovered per second = (flat regeneration + maximum Mana × percentage regeneration) × (1 + Regeneration Rate ÷ 100) × (1 + Recovery Rate ÷ 100). Regeneration Rate improves regeneration; Recovery Rate also improves eligible leech and on-kill gains.

Physical Damage Leeched as Mana recovers Mana over time, not instantly. Increased Mana Leech and Mana Recovery Rate improve its amount; normal leech pool and recovery limits still apply. Health on Kill and Mana on Kill grant immediate recovery when you receive kill credit. Animals count for these on-kill effects.

Vaal Pact disables life regeneration. Zealot's Oath sends life regeneration to [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]]. Ghost Reaver disables normal [[stat/cranks-dungeons:energy_shield|Energy Shield]] recharge. These keystones require a deliberate alternate recovery plan.
